snippet.title: Pocket Kanon/Air Game
snippet.description: Im playing Pocket Kanon/Air.The game is quite a fun and it can at least kill some time.Im playing as Nayuki from Kanon and my enemy is the demon hunter Mai,also from Kanon.The battle was pretty easy(I burned Mai too fast!!!)If you like the game or any of the animes Air and Kanon you can send me a message that you want this game or want to talk about any of the animes.If any of you want me to make more videos of this game just send me a request.
